subject: Cross-cloud runbook demo: slot requests + backup plan

Subject: Cross-cloud runbook demo: initial slot proposals

Hi Aisha / Alex —

Thanks again for agreeing to do the joint runs with CloudBridge + AWS next week. We want this to be a short, focused 45‑minute technical primer (30 min demo + 15 min Q&A) showing:
- Redwood inference routing across Azure/GCP/AWS
- Failover behavior and fallback to quantized model when capacity drops
- Observability: per-model latency and cost dashboards

Proposed slots (PDT):
- Tue 23 Jun, 10:00–10:45
- Wed 24 Jun, 13:00–13:45
- Thu 25 Jun, 08:00–08:45 (for APAC participants)

Can you confirm which slot works and whether you prefer Alex or Marcus to lead the hands‑on portion? Also, we have a short runbook draft attached — please skim and call out any gaps.

Attachments: [runbook-v1.pdf (PDF, 1.2MB)]

Thanks,
Mark Chen
Sr. Partnerships Manager, CloudBridge
mark.chen@cloudbridge.com

Thanks Mark — this is great. Quick responses: 

- Best slot for our customer-facing team: Wed 24 Jun, 13:00–13:45 PDT. That gives us time to rehearse Mon/Tue morning.
- Lead: Alex Martinez will run the demo; Marcus Lin will own the failover/fallback segment and instrumentation walkthrough.

Two small asks before we lock:
1) Can CloudBridge share the attendee list (roles + timezones) so we can trim the demo depth for execs vs. infra?
2) For the APAC slot you listed, we prefer recording + async Q&A rather than a live run unless there are 2–3 APAC engineers attending.

I attached a quick change to the runbook (minor sequencing notes) and a slide that outlines the failover stories.

Attachments: [runbook-v1.pdf (updated), slides-dryrun.pptx]

Locking in Wed 24 Jun 13:00–13:45 PDT works for me. A few technical notes so CloudBridge knows what to expect during the 30‑minute demo:

Planned flow (30m):
- 00:00–03:00: quick intro + agenda (Aisha)
- 03:00–12:00: model routing & latency SLOs (Alex)
- 12:00–22:00: failover demo + KV cache behavior under node loss (Marcus)
- 22:00–30:00: instrumentation walkthrough (logs, token-level cost) + next steps

Technical constraints / asks from our side:
- Please confirm a shared test account or short‑lived API key we can use for live calls (read‑only).
- If you plan to demo cross‑region routing, give us the exact region pairs (e.g., us-west2 -> europe-west1) so we can stage compatible fallback models.

Backup plan suggestion (in case of environment or network issues):
- Fall back to a recorded short demo (12m) hosted in the Drive link below; follow-up live Q&A for engineers.


--
Alex Martinez
Principal Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

- API access: Samira, please send the short‑lived read‑only API key to alex_martinez@redwoodinference.com (or the connection string) and cc me.
- Rehearsal: Alex and Marcus will do a 30‑minute dry run Mon 22 Jun, 09:00–09:30 PDT — invite sent.
- Backup: If live demo fails, we'll play the recorded 12m clip and then open the floor to engineers for deep dives.
